**Position Summary**
--------------------


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Within our Functional Service Provider (FSP) organization, the **GPS Functional Project Manager, Process \& Operations** plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of Global Patient Safety (GPS) services by driving operational excellence, leading strategic initiatives, and continuously improving business processes.


This role combines project management, operational leadership, process optimization, and stakeholder engagement to ensure consistent execution of business priorities across global teams. The successful candidate will partner with internal functional leaders, client stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to implement scalable solutions, improve operational performance, and support high\-quality service delivery in a regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Project Management**

* Lead and manage strategic functional and operational initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, risk registers, and success metrics.
* Coordinate cross\-functional project teams to ensure timely delivery of agreed objectives.
* Facilitate governance meetings, project workshops, and stakeholder reviews.
* Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation strategies while escalating critical decisions when appropriate.
* Prepare executive\-level project updates, dashboards, status reports, and presentations.
* Ensure projects align with Thermo Fisher Scientific operational standards, client expectations, and business objectives.

### **Process \& Operational Excellence**

* Evaluate, document, and optimize operational workflows across Global Patient Safety functions.
* Lead process mapping, gap analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Develop standardized operating procedures, process documentation, templates, and best practices.
* Define and monitor operational performance indicators (KPIs) and process effectiveness metrics.
* Support implementation of sustainable process improvements through change management activities.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement.

### **Knowledge Management \& Business Operations**

* Maintain operational knowledge repositories, SharePoint sites, collaboration platforms, and business documentation.
* Ensure onboarding materials, training resources, governance documentation, and functional communications remain current and accessible.
* Coordinate inputs from subject matter experts to maintain accurate operational content.
* Support business planning activities, governance forums, leadership meetings, and operational communications.
* Track recurring operational deliverables and ensure timely completion of business commitments.
* Champion effective utilization of project portfolio management and collaboration tools.

### **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build collaborative relationships with internal functional leaders, delivery teams, quality, technology, and client stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Translate business requirements into practical project plans and operational solutions.
* Provide leadership in coordinating complex initiatives across multiple functions.
* Influence stakeholders through strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Business, Public Health, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.
* Minimum 3 years of project management, PMO, business operations, process excellence, or consulting experience.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional projects within complex global organizations.
* Experience with business process mapping, process redesign, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and project management tools.
* Knowledge of project portfolio management systems (e.g., Planisware, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar).
* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification preferred.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Global Patient Safety, Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, or other GxP\-regulated functions.
* Experience within Functional Service Provider (FSP) or Contract Research Organization (CRO) environments.
* Experience supporting global client partnerships and matrix organizations.
* Lean Six Sigma or continuous improvement certification is advantageous.
* Experience with organizational change management or business transformation initiatives.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Project \& Program Management
* Operational Excellence
* Business Process Improvement
* Continuous Improvement
* Stakeholder \& Client Management
* Change Management
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Governance \& Business Operations
* Strategic Planning \& Execution
* Communication \& Influencing
* Cross\-functional Leadership
* Quality \& Compliance
* Analytical Problem Solving

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll join a global organization committed to advancing science and improving patient outcomes. We provide opportunities to work alongside industry\-leading experts, support world\-class pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners, and contribute to meaningful projects that impact global healthcare. Our culture promotes innovation, collaboration, professional development, and continuous learning while empowering employees to grow their careers in an inclusive and purpose\-driven environment.

description:
### **Brenntag, the global market leader in the distribution of chemicals and ingredients, supports customers and partners with high\-quality technical, commercial, and logistical solutions.**

### **To strengthen our Pharma Business Unit, we are looking for a** **Regulatory Affairs Specialist** **with a technical background in pharmaceutical or related industries, particularly with experience in regulatory documentation and compliance.**

### **The successful candidate will join the EMEA team and will be responsible, with a high degree of autonomy, for managing all regulatory aspects of the pharma business across the region.**

### **As a key member of the Pharma team, you will support the EMEA division on all regulatory, quality, compliance, legal, and product stewardship topics related to the supply of a large portfolio of raw materials into the pharmaceutical industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide accurate, timely, and audit‑ready documentation to pharmaceutical customers and to support regulatory deliverables for bespoke product projects.**

### **The role is primarily office‑based, with occasional travel required for supplier meetings, customer visits, audits, or internal workshops.**

### **You will collaborate closely with commercial, supply chain, QHSE, and supplier partners to ensure that all materials supplied meet applicable pharmaceutical regulations and industry standards.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Customer Documentation \& Regulatory Support:**

* ### **Prepare, review, and issue** **technical and regulatory documentation** **required by pharmaceutical customers, including:**


	+ ### **Quality \& Technical Agreements**
	+ ### **Supply Chain Statements**
	+ ### **Regulatory Questionnaires**
	+ ### **Compliance Statements (e.g., TSE/BSE, GMO, allergens, nitrosamines, residual solvents, elemental impurities)**
* ### **Ensure all documentation is accurate, consistent and aligned with applicable frameworks (i.e. relevant pharmacopoeia, IPEC Guidelines, EU GDP and GMP guidelines.**

* ### **Source regulatory, quality, and technical information internally and from suppliers to fulfil customer requests.**
* ### **Evaluate supplier documentation for completeness, compliance, and suitability for pharmaceutical use.**

### **Customer Request Management**

* ### **Log, track, and report customer documentation requests using defined KPIs.**
* ### **Support continuous improvement by identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities to streamline documentation processes.**

### **Support for Customer Value Added Service Projects**

* ### **Lead and manage regulatory deliverables for customer\-specific projects.**
* ### **Coordinate regulatory assessments, supplier data collection, and compliance documentation for new product introductions or customised specifications.**
* ### **Support change control evaluations and customer notifications.**

### **Regulatory Compliance \& Standards Implementation**

* ### **Work with QHSE and supply chain teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards (IPEC GMP/GDP, EXCiPACT, GDP, and other regulatory frameworks).**
* ### **Support implementation of new regulatory requirements and internal standards across the business unit.**

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* ### **Partner with commercial and value\-added services teams to provide regulatory expertise for customer projects and commercial initiatives.**
* ### **Contribute to global Pharma Regulatory team projects, harmonisation efforts, and continuous improvement activities.**

### **Training \& Knowledge Sharing**

* ### **Deliver training to commercial, supply chain, and internal teams on regulatory topics relevant to supply of materials into the pharmaceutical industry.**
* ### **Act as a subject matter expert for documentation, compliance, and regulatory expectations.**

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* ### **Perform any other tasks within capability to support the commercial, regulatory, and compliance success of the Pharma business unit.**

### **Qualifications \& Experience**

* ### **Degree in a life science discipline (chemistry, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences) or equivalent relevant experience.**
* ### **Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical industry requirements for APIs, excipients, biopharma materials, and traditional pharma raw materials.**
* ### **Understanding of European National Competent Authority requirements for distribution of APIs, excipients, and raw materials.**

### **Skills \& Competencies**

* ### **Fluent in English and Italian (spoken and written).**
* ### **Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and compliant documentation.**
* ### **Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work proactively across all levels and functions.**
* ### **Ability to interpret regulations, resolve compliance issues, and respond to complex regulatory queries.**
* ### **High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.**
* ### **Willingness to undertake occasional travel for customer meetings, supplier visits, audits, or internal workshops.**

### **Our Offer**

The final compensation package will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable EU pay transparency and equal pay requirements.**

**Senior Product Manager in Healthcare**

Full\-time · Milan · Italian required

**The role**

Vermed is an AI\-native healthcare startup building software products for healthcare organisations in Italy. We use the latest advances in AI throughout our products, software\-development workflow, and business processes, helping a focused team build and support multiple products. Some of our products already support services accessible to millions of people across Italy. Our goal is to improve health outcomes and reduce the administrative burden on healthcare professionals.

English is Vermed's company working language. Fluent Italian is required for this position and to work with Italian healthcare organisations.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product direction for a complex new healthcare product intended to work across multiple Italian regions. Its first version is still in active development, so this is an opportunity to shape the product while its core workflows, capabilities, and operating model are being defined.

You will own product decisions: understanding the problems that matter, setting direction, deciding what to prioritise, and ensuring that what we build creates measurable value for healthcare professionals, organisations, and citizens.

The product must work across regional contexts. You will turn differences in healthcare organisations, workflows, priorities, and institutional constraints into a coherent and reusable product direction.

**What you'll do**

* Own product strategy, roadmap, prioritisation, and measurable outcomes for the product.
* Work closely with healthcare stakeholders in different Italian regions to understand needs, constraints, and operating models.
* Conduct discovery with clinicians, operators, hospital management, regional stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.
* Translate healthcare workflows, user needs, institutional constraints, and commercial context into clear product decisions and requirements.
* Guide the product from discovery and validation through implementation, rollout, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with engineering, design, integration, commercial, regulatory, and delivery colleagues.

* Manage stakeholder expectations across complex healthcare implementation and public\-sector decision cycles.
* Shape responsible AI\- and LLM\-enabled experiences, including quality evaluation, human oversight, privacy, and failure handling.
* Communicate product direction and trade\-offs clearly in both Italian and English.

* Approximately five or more years in product roles, with meaningful end\-to\-end product ownership.

* Experience working with Italian regions, hospitals, IRCCS, ASL/USL, or technology suppliers serving them.
* Excellent product discovery, prioritisation, written communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.

This is a full\-time, Milan\-based position with a hybrid work from home / office working model. The role includes regular, pre\-planned in\-person workshops in Milan and meetings with healthcare customers and partners in different Italian regions.

With a team of 220\+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz.

**Our vision**


Our vision is to combine passion, expertise, and technology to provide best\-in\-class investment solutions and advice that protects and grows client wealth over time.

**Our Core Values:**

* Relationships are our first asset: We’re one team, built on trust, honesty, and transparency. We value our relationships above all else.
* Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact.
* Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We’re always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream

**What this means in practice:**


At Moneyfarm, our success comes from the impact each of us makes. We move with purpose, urgency, and ambition, focused on delivering outcomes that matter for our clients and our business. Everyone is empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and turn bold ideas into results. As we evolve, we embrace AI as a catalyst for sharper thinking, smarter decisions, and even greater impact.


Our diversity makes this possible. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our creativity and drive better decisions — it’s our competitive edge. We value people for who they are and their unique strengths: that's why we offer flexible ways of working to support them in doing their best work.

**About the role**


Moneyfarm is seeking a proactive and experienced Italian Financial Controller to take full ownership of our accounting, tax, and regulatory financial reporting functions in Italy for a period of 6\-9 months.


Reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller/CFO, you will oversee end\-to\-end local financial operations for our Italian legal entities:

* MFM Investment Ltd (Italian Branch / MFM Italy): Authorised and supervised by CONSOB and the Bank of Italy (BOI).
* MFM Future SRL: Registered insurance broking entity regulated by IVASS.


In this position, you will lead a local team of 2 finance professionals in Milan, collaborate closely with Group Finance and FP\&A, and manage key relationships with external advisers and audit partners.

 **Responsibilities**:


Core focus (essential)


1\. Financial Reporting \& Accounting Operations

* + Lead end\-to\-end accounting for the Italian entities, ensuring the general ledger in NetSuite is accurate, complete and up to date.
	+ Direct all statutory, management, and general ledger accounting operations for MFM Italy and MFM Future SRL in accordance with local Italian accounting standards (OIC) and IFRS.
	+ Oversee and optimise our core ERP platform (NetSuite), driving accuracy, ledger maintenance, and process automation.
	+ Lead month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close processes, ensuring accurate local statutory account preparation and timely financial consolidation into Group reporting.


2\. Tax Management \& Intercompany Operations

* + Oversee Italian direct and indirect tax compliance (IRES, IRAP, withholding taxes, clients’ capital gains taxes, and VAT).
	+ Manage calculations and reporting for local partial VAT exemption (pro\-rata VAT) applicable to our regulated financial and insurance services.
	+ Lead local Transfer Pricing (TP) documentation for intercompany transactions between UK and Italian entities, working closely with external tax advisers for specialist support.
	+ Partner with the FP\&A team (who execute the TP calculations) to ensure intercompany charges are accurately documented and reflected across entity accounts.
	+ Monitor changes in Italian tax and financial services regulation, assessing and communicating impact on the business.

**Additional Responsibilities**


3\. Regulatory Compliance Support \& Governance

* + Oversee the financial data preparation and timely submission of local financial regulatory reports across both entities:
	+ - Bank of Italy (BOI) and CONSOB filings for the Italian Branch.
		- IVASS regulatory reporting for MFM Future SRL.
	+ Work closely with internal compliance teams, regulatory advisers, and external audit teams to ensure full financial regulatory compliance in Italy.


4\. Leadership \& Stakeholder Management

* + Report regularly to the Group Financial Controller/CFO on local entity performance, regulatory updates, and balance sheet integrity.
	+ Manage, mentor, and develop a local finance team of two people in Italy.
	+ Partner closely with the FP\&A team on budgeting, management reporting commentary, variance analysis, and TP calculation integration.
	+ Maintain effective cross\-functional relationships internally, as well as with external banking partners, advisers, and tax consultants.

  

**Requirements**  

* + Education \& Qualification: Master's Degree (Laurea Magistrale) in Economics, Finance, or Accounting. Professional accounting/auditing qualification (Dottore Commercialista or Revisore Legale) is strongly preferred.
	+ Experience: 8/10\+ years of relevant accounting and financial control experience, ideally (but not limited to) within regulated Financial Services, Wealth Management, Asset Management, or Fintech in Italy.
	+ Experience in accounting firms will be highly regarded.

**DESCRIPTION**

Reinvent how the world's largest robotics network gets deployed.  

Amazon is seeking a Senior Manager for our Robotics Delivery, Packaging \& Innovation to define and lead the Design for Deployment (DfD) technical deep\-dive, and associated implementation strategy, across our global robotics fulfillment network. * Serve as the organization's DfD technical authority, overview engineering drawings, mechatronic designs, and controls architectures, to embed quantified deployment requirements into engineering design, providing a single consolidated deployment voice and force multiplying deployment teams across multiple technology programs.

* Perform controlled maintenance activities such as firmware upgrades, switch upgrades, host OS updates, GPU driver updates, BIOS changes, and hardware replacements.

### **Platform observability and validation**

### **Cross\-team coordination**


* Work closely with the Senior Director of Infrastructure Operations.
* Work closely with Staff Network, Staff Storage, Sr Hardware/Infrastructure, Sr Platform, Sr Fleet Automation, Observability, Product Engineering, Sales Engineering, and Service Delivery roles.
* Provide field feedback into reference architectures, BOMs, rack layouts, cabling standards, deployment playbooks, and validation procedures.

**Technical Stack**

------------------

### **Clinical Trial \& Documentation Support**

* Coordinate and complete assigned clinical trial activities in accordance with the study task matrix.
* Perform Country and Investigator file reviews and document findings in the appropriate systems.
* Support audit and inspection readiness by ensuring study files are reviewed according to applicable schedules and procedures.

* Support the preparation, compilation, and distribution of Investigator Site Files (ISFs), pharmacy binders, and study supplies.
* Assist with study\-specific translations and translation quality control, as required.

### **Site Activation \& Regulatory Support**

* Provide administrative support for site activation and start\-up activities.
* Work with internal teams to help ensure site start\-up activities remain aligned with the site's activation critical path and project timelines.
* Support regulatory submissions and the tracking of local regulatory documentation.

* Support effective site follow\-up plans and escalate concerns or potential risks appropriately.
* Liaise with relevant internal teams to support the timely resolution of investigator queries.

* Provide support for clinical trial systems such as **Activate, eTMF**, and other study platforms.
* Help ensure study databases and systems remain accurate and up to date.
* Maintain study\-specific documentation, team lists, project training requirements, activity plans, and vendor trackers.
* Support Risk\-Based Monitoring (RBM) activities where applicable.
* Assist with scheduling internal and client meetings as required.
* Support study communications, including document distribution, reports, and project\-specific mailings.
* Collaborate closely with project team members to achieve targeted study milestones and deadlines.
* Communicate site\-related issues and potential risks to appropriate clinical and project colleagues.

* Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently while working to project deadlines.
* Ability to analyze project\-specific information and systems to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Strong customer\-focused mindset.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities and study timelines.
* Interest in developing a strong working knowledge of **ICH\-GCP**, applicable Italian and European regulations, and clinical research procedures.

* Good judgment, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to follow study\-specific procedures and project instructions accurately.
* Ability to identify potential risks and escalate them appropriately.
* Self\-motivated with a positive and proactive approach to work.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Working Environment \& Travel**
---------------------------------


This position is primarily performed in an **office and/or home\-office environment**, depending on business requirements.

* Regular travel is not a core requirement of the role.
* Occasional travel or driving to clinical trial sites may be required depending on study needs.
* The position provides exposure to a wide range of clinical trial activities, systems, and cross\-functional teams, supporting continued development within clinical research.

**Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific?**
--------------------------------------


When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team committed to accelerating scientific discovery and improving patient outcomes.


We offer:

* An excellent opportunity to **build and develop your career in clinical research**.
* Exposure to international clinical trials and global project teams.

description:

Humanitas Research Hospital is looking for an Animal Technician for the Immunology in Cardiovascular Pathologies Lab, to join the cardiovascular research team led by Gianluigi Condorelli. You will contribute directly to the quality of preclinical studies by combining animal care, experimental precision, and reliable management of samples and data.
  
  

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to grow in a multidisciplinary scientific environment, build specialist technical skills, and progressively gain greater autonomy, always in compliance with animal welfare standards, the 3Rs, and approved procedures.
  
  

Why this role
  
Work alongside researchers, veterinarians, and animal facility staff on preclinical cardiovascular studies.
  
Follow a structured training and mentoring pathway, with competency assessment before working independently.
  
Broaden your experience in in vivo procedures, perioperative monitoring, sample collection, and functional data, depending on project needs and authorizations.
  
Make a tangible contribution to animal welfare, study reproducibility, and the quality of the data generated.
  
What you will do
  
Monitor general condition, behavior, body weight, food and water intake, and other protocol\-defined parameters on a daily basis.
  
Apply score sheets, humane endpoints, and escalation criteria together with the designated veterinarian and study team.
  
Manage animal acclimatization, identification, handling, environmental enrichment, and traceability in line with internal procedures.
  
Prepare materials and equipment and support the pre\-, intra\-, and post\-procedural phases of cardiovascular studies within the scope of documented training.
  
Collect and manage biological samples and functional data, ensuring correct timing, labeling, and traceability.
  
Complete clinical records, experimental logs, and databases accurately and promptly.
  
Report anomalies or critical issues and contribute to the management of materials, equipment, SOPs, and operational checklists.
  
Who we are looking for
  
What matters most
  
A technical or scientific diploma, or a degree in biology, biotechnology, veterinary medicine, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline.
  
Practical experience, including internships, in an animal facility, preclinical laboratory, veterinary setting, or another regulated technical or scientific environment.
  
Basic knowledge of animal welfare, biosafety, SOPs, and the 3Rs, or strong motivation to develop this knowledge during onboarding.
  
Accuracy in following protocols and maintaining documentation, with confidence using records and digital tools.
  
Good reading comprehension of scientific English and willingness to complete the required training before working independently.
  
It would be an advantage to have
  
One to three years of experience in an animal facility or preclinical laboratory.
  
Experience with in vivo cardiovascular models and species relevant to the research programs.
  
Hands\-on experience with anesthesia and analgesia under supervision, perioperative monitoring, sampling, necropsy, or tissue collection.
  
Familiarity with cardiovascular endpoints, data acquisition software, LIMS/ELN systems, or facility databases.
  
  

Junior candidates with a relevant scientific background, good manual dexterity, and motivation to grow are encouraged to apply: you do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We are committed to equal opportunities throughout the selection process.
  
  

Skills you can contribute and develop
  
Low\-stress handling and clinical and behavioral monitoring of animals.
  
Preparation of sterile or aseptic setups, materials, medicines, and basic equipment.
  
Support for authorized procedures, supervised anesthesia and analgesia, recovery, and sample collection.
  
Accurate management of samples and data, with close attention to timing, labeling, archiving, and anomalies.
  
Progressive familiarity with physiological parameters, hemodynamic measurements, imaging, and other project\-specific cardiovascular endpoints.
  
How you work
  
You are reliable, precise, and attentive to detail.
  
You communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team.
  
You can manage changing priorities while maintaining high standards of animal welfare, safety, and quality.
  
You work with ethical awareness, personal responsibility, and a willingness to learn.
  
What you will find
  
A multidisciplinary scientific environment and structured onboarding covering the facility, SOPs, biosafety, animal welfare, and technical procedures.
  
Hands\-on mentoring and progressive autonomy based on acquired competencies and authorized activities.
  
A one year fellowship, renewable up to a total maximum of three years; full\-time commitment with an expected start in October 2026\.
  
  

Send your CV and a brief cover note by 10 September 2026\. Tell us about any training you have completed, the species you have worked with, and the experimental techniques you know.
